status: explicitly human-requested diagnostic follow-up; not a Phase 3 mechanism evaluation
seed_reason: Deterministic gain crossing and fixed coordinate changes, not population samples or fitted hyperparameters.

reader_interfaces.own_feature_api: Current weights and unlabeled A/B features generated by the learner's own supplied fixed encoder; no additional experience-dependent persistent state. Zero initialization, fixed map and A-then-B rank-one updates remain supplied contracts.
reader_interfaces.learned_update_spans: Current weights, canonical bases estimated from actual A and B update deltas, current unlabeled A query feature; no gains, labels, boundary weights, geometry IDs or arm IDs. At most four additional floating scalars plus rank/context metadata persist.
reader_interfaces.erased_geometry_view: Current weights and current unlabeled A query only; deliberately removes the original model's callable B feature map as well as the update-span trace. Its ambiguity result is not an impossibility result for the original supplied-map learner.

scope_exclusions: No autonomous invention or selection of the decoder
No unknown-world exploration or primitive discovery
No installation of recovery into the predictor's training or action path
No old target/label replay, saved boundary estimate or coordinate-specific recovery formula
No population prevalence, frontier-model or biological inference
No automatic strengthening or demotion of the broad bottleneck ranking
No novelty, feasibility or candidate mechanism screening
